title: Customer Visit Preparation Flow
titleZh: 客户拜访准备确定性工作流

nodes.label: Visit Prep Request
nodes.description: Extract customer clue, visit purpose, and relationship-only flag
nodes.descriptionZh: 接收客户名称/联系人线索与拜访目标

nodes.label: Extract Target & Intent
nodes.labelZh: 提取客户线索与拜访意图
nodes.description: Zero-LLM slot extraction for company query, pricing interest, and visit type
nodes.descriptionZh: 毫秒级提取目标企业名称、是否关注报价及是否纯关系维护

company.pattern: (?:拜访|见|关于|准备|准备一下|调研)\s*([\u4e00-\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}?)(?:的|公司|集团|客户|拜访|简报|$)

nodes.label: Identify Customer (CRM)
nodes.description: Search CRM companies to verify identity or detect multiple candidates
nodes.descriptionZh: 调用 list_companies 核验客户唯一身份或发现多候选同名企业

nodes.label: Disambiguation Gate
nodes.description: Route based on CRM match count (>1 candidates, 1 unique match, or 0 found)
nodes.descriptionZh: 按匹配数量自动分流：多候选暂停确认、唯一匹配拉取 CRM 事实、查无直接进产品匹配

nodes.label: Ask User to Select Customer
nodes.description: Stop without guessing and ask the user to pick the exact company
nodes.descriptionZh: 发现多个合理候选，展示真实企业名称请用户选择，严禁模型自动猜测
nodes.promptTemplate:
Found multiple matching companies for "{{vars.company}}". Please select which one to prepare the visit brief for:
{{steps.lookup.candidateNames}}
nodes.promptTemplateZh:
在 CRM 中检索到多个与“{{vars.company}}”匹配的候选企业，请确认本次拜访的具体对象：
{{steps.lookup.candidateNames}}

nodes.label: Parallel CRM Facts
nodes.labelZh: 并行拉取 CRM 权威事实
nodes.description: Fetch company profile, active deals, and recent activities concurrently via Promise.all
nodes.descriptionZh: 并发调用 get_company、list_deals、list_activities 一次性补齐客户、商机与互动事实

nodes.label: Parallel Product & Case Match
nodes.labelZh: 并行匹配我司产品与案例
nodes.description: Concurrently search product docs, success cases, and optional quote catalog
nodes.descriptionZh: 并发检索产品文档、成功案例及报价目录（纯关系维护拜访自动标记 skipped）

nodes.label: Synthesize Visit Briefing
nodes.description: 1-turn LLM synthesis strictly separating CRM facts, product evidence, and unverified gaps
nodes.descriptionZh: 单次模型调用生成完整拜访简报：明确区分 CRM 事实、我司资料、待核实假设与信息缺口
